fontlab.doc: High-level FontLab editing API. flGlyph contains drawing layers, flLayer contains shapes, and flContour contains nodes. CurrentFont() and CurrentGlyph() access the active editing context.

fontlab.flGlyph.doc:
A FontLab editing glyph containing flLayer objects. The captured declaration exposes `name` and `layers`; iterate `layers` to inspect layer names. Unicode assignments belong to the associated fontgate glyph; they are not flGlyph attributes.

Example::

    glyph = fl.CurrentGlyph()
    if glyph:
        print(glyph.name)
        for layer in glyph.layers:
            print(layer.name)

fontlab.flNode.doc: A contour node. The captured declaration exposes `x`, `y`, `type` and `smooth`. The `type` member distinguishes on-curve points from off-curve control points. Read or assign `x` and `y` on the original native object.

fontgate.doc: Low-level FontLab font data API. fgFont provides glyphs, naming data, features and kerning; fgGlyph provides glyph data. Feature data is exposed by fgFont.features; there is no captured module-level fgFeatures class.

fontgate.fgFont.doc: A font data object. The captured declaration exposes `glyphs`, `info`, `features`, `kerning` and `axes`. Access naming information through `info`; the captured fgFont has no family attribute. Consult each native member declaration for its return type and calling convention.

fontgate.fgGlyph.doc:
A glyph data object. The captured declaration exposes `name`, `unicode`, `unicodes`, `width`, `anchors` and `components`. Outlines are associated with layer data rather than a contours attribute.

Example::

    print(glyph.name)
    print(glyph.unicode)
    print(glyph.width)

fontgate.fgContour.doc: A contour in the fontgate data model. The captured declaration exposes `nodes`, `getNodes`, `getNode`, `countNodes` and `open`. Consult the native declarations for supported calling conventions.

fontgate.fgPoint.doc: A two-dimensional point. The captured declaration exposes the coordinates `x` and `y` and the native vector operations. The captured fgPoint has no point type attribute. Read `x` and `y` or use `asTuple` to inspect coordinates.

fontlab.flAnchor.doc: An editing anchor whose `name` identifies the object and whose `anchorPoint` holds its QPointF position. The captured declaration exposes `isGlobal`, `fixHorzDirection` and `fixVertDirection` as boolean attributes. Consult the retained constructor documentation for supported creation forms.

fontlab.flGuideLine.doc: An editing guideline with `angle`, `centerPoint` and `vectorPoint` attributes. The captured declaration identifies `centerPoint` and `vectorPoint` as QPointF values, and `linef` as a QLineF. `name` identifies the object; `color` is a QColor value. Consult the retained constructors for supported line and point forms.

fontlab.flShape.doc: An editing shape with a `contours` collection of flContour objects. `getContours()` also returns its contours, and `contoursCount` reports their count. `boundingBox` is a QRectF attribute. Read the captured boolean attributes `isComponent` and `isComposite` to inspect the shape kind.

fontgate.fgAnchor.doc: A font-data anchor with `name`, `x` and `y` attributes. `position` exposes its coordinates as an fgPoint. `draw()` sends the anchor to a segment pen; `drawPoints()` uses a point pen. Consult the retained constructors for copying and named coordinate forms.

fontgate.fgLayer.doc: A font-data layer exposing `name`, `anchors`, `guides` and `hints`. The captured declarations identify those collections as fgAnchors, fgGuides and fgHints. `countContours()` and `countShapes()` report contour and shape counts; `addContour()` adds an fgContour and returns an fgContour. Consult the member documentation for transformation and bounding-box arguments.

fontgate.fgShape.doc: A font-data shape whose `contours` attribute holds fgContours. `countContours()` and `countNodes()` report outline counts; `addContour()` adds an fgContour. `matrix` exposes an fgMatrix, while `name` and `opacity` describe the shape.

fontlab.FontMetrics.doc: Vertical metrics record for a font. The captured declaration exposes `upm`, `ascender`, `descender`, `lineGap`, `capsHeight` and `xHeight` as numeric (double) attributes, and `init` for initialisation. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms, which take a units-per-em value, an existing record, or a package with a layer name.

fontlab.flZone.doc: An alignment zone described by `position` and `width` (both double), with `name`, `tags`, `program` and `programText` attributes. The captured declaration also exposes `guaranteeName`, `tagsSet` and `toZone`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms.

fontlab.CurveEx.doc: A curve segment record. The captured declaration exposes the end points `p0` and `p1`, the control points `bcp0` and `bcp1`, the control vectors `bcv0` and `bcv1`, the bounding rectangle `brect`, and the index attributes `leftIdx`, `rightIdx` and `contourIx`. Captured methods include `split`, `extremum`, `smooth`, `improve`, `fastLength` and `applyTransform`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported point-based creation forms.

fontlab.fgSymbol.doc: A glyph reference identified by `unicode`, `name`, `id` and `pid`, with the flags `hasName`, `hasUnicode` and `empty`. The captured declaration exposes `glyph` (returning a glyph for a font), `computeID`, `compare`, `clear`, and `data`, `setData`, `containsData` and `clearData` keyed by the `DataCode` attribute. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms. Caution: FontLab 9.0.9809 terminates when fgSymbol() is called with no arguments (Fontlab/fl#8632, open).

fontlab.flObject.doc: Base editing object. The captured declaration exposes identity and state attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `refCnt`, `isValid`, `isNull`, `isPresent`, `isReleased`, `isChanged` and `hasChanges`. Captured methods cover properties (`getProperty`, `setProperty`, `getProperties`), flags (`flag`, `setFlag`, `clearFlag`), history states (`historyStates`, `restoreHistoryState`, `hasHistoryState`) and object lifetime (`clone`, `release`, `remove`, `update`, `changed`).

fontlab.flPinPoint.doc: A pin point object with a `point` position, a `style`, an `appearance` value and the boolean attributes `anchor`, `isLatch`, `markEnabled`, `cloudEnabled` and `hasExpression`, plus the text attributes `expressionX` and `expressionY`. The captured declaration also exposes `translate`, `createInstance` and the object property, flag and history methods shared with the base editing object.

fontgate.fgKerning.doc: The kerning table of a font. The captured declaration exposes `get` and `set` for a value addressed by a pair or by a tuple of two names, `has_key`, `keys`, `values`, `items`, `asDict`, `remove` and `clear`, and the group operations `addGroup`, `deleteGroup`, `deleteAllGroups`, `renameGroup` and `hasGroupKerning`. It also exposes `getPlainPairs`, `getPlainPairsDict`, `setPlainPairs`, `scale` and the `groups` attribute.

fontgate.fgKerningGroups.doc: A dictionary of kerning groups. The captured declaration exposes `has_key`, `keys`, `values`, `items`, `asDict`, `clear`, `remove` and `rename`. Each item is a group name with a list of glyph names and a mode.

fontgate.fgKerningObject.doc: One side of a kerning pair: a glyph or a group. The captured declaration exposes `id` (the glyph or group name) and `mode` (glyphMode or groupMode), with `asDict` and `asTuple`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms.

fontgate.fgKerningObjectPair.doc: A kerning pair made of a `left` and a `right` kerning object, each a glyph or a group, with `asDict` and `asTuple`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms, which take names, kerning objects or a tuple of two kerning objects.

fontlab.Interval.doc: A numeric interval with `t0` and `t1` (both double) and `d` and `key` attributes. The captured declaration exposes `isEmpty`, `middle`, `reversed`, `setT0T1`, `toAbsolute` and `toInterval`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms.

fontlab.PaintBrush.doc: A paint brush described by `angle`, `flatness` and `size` (all double) and a `shape` attribute. The captured declaration exposes `assign`, `init`, `render` and `toString`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms.

fontlab.flInstance.doc: A font instance with the string attributes `name`, `sgn`, `tsn`, `weight` and `width`, the bool attributes `bold`, `exportable` and `italic`, the numeric attributes `slv` (int) and `weightValue` (double), and a `location` attribute. The captured declaration exposes `autoSGN`, `autoSLV`, `autoTSN` and `setSLV`. It is created as `flInstance()` or as `flInstance(name, tsn, location)`.

fontlab.flStem.doc: A stem described by `value` (double), with `name`, `tags`, `program` and `programText` attributes. The captured declaration also exposes `guaranteeName`, `linear`, `ppm`, `tagsSet` and `toStem`. Consult the retained constructor documentation for the supported creation forms.

fontlab.flTTHCommand.doc: A TrueType hinting command with `code`, `parameters` and `point_names` attributes. The captured declaration exposes `fromString`, `isDelta`, `isFinal`, `isHorizontal`, `isVertical`, `nodesCount`, `parametersCount`, `stemIndex` and `zoneIndex`. It is created as `flTTHCommand()`.

fontgate.fgGroup.doc: A kerning or metrics group with an int `id`, a string `name` and a `mode`. The captured mode values are `'FeaClassGroupMode'`, `'KernLeftGroupMode'`, `'KernRightGroupMode'` and `'KernBothSideGroupMode'`. The captured declaration exposes `isBoth`, `isFeaGroup`, `isLeft` and `isRight`. It is created as `fgGroup()`, as a copy `fgGroup(fgGroup)` or as `fgGroup(('name', [ids], mode, 'mainglyphname'))`.

fontgate.fgMatrix.doc: A transformation matrix with the attributes `m11`, `m12`, `m21`, `m22`, `dx` and `dy`. The captured declaration exposes `asDict`, `asTuple`, `assign`, `determinant`, `invert`, `inverted`, `invertible`, `noMove`, `noRotate`, `noScale`, `scale`, `slant` and `standard`. It is created as `fgMatrix()`, as a copy `fgMatrix(fgMatrix)` or as `fgMatrix(m11, m12, m21, m22, dx, dy)`; two matrices combine with `fgMatrix * fgMatrix`.

fontgate.fgPen.doc: A pen with a bool `smooth` attribute. The captured declaration exposes `beginPath`, `closePath`, `curveTo`, `curveToOne`, `endPath`, `lineTo`, `moveTo` and `qCurveToOne`. It is created as `fgPen(fgGlyph)` or as a copy `fgPen(fgPen)`.

fontgate.fgStem.doc: A stem described by a string `name`, a float `value` and a `program` dict of int to int. The captured declaration exposes `clear`, `fillProgram`, `ppm` and `setProgram`. It is created as `fgStem()`, as a copy `fgStem(fgStem)` or as `fgStem(value)`.

fontgate.fgZone.doc: A zone described by a string `name`, float `position` and `width`, a bool `top` and a `program` dict of int to int. The captured declaration exposes `clear`, `getIntValues`, `v0` and `v1`. It is created as `fgZone()` or as a copy `fgZone(fgZone)`.

fontlab.AccentInfo.doc: A data wrapper with the attributes `layer` and `offset`. The captured declaration exposes `asDict` (represent the object as a dictionary) and `asTuple` (represent it as a tuple).

fontlab.GlyphComponent.doc: A glyph component described by `name_id` (uint), `transform` (QTransform), `use_anchors` (bool) and `width_scale` (double). It is created as `GlyphComponent()`, as a copy `GlyphComponent(GlyphComponent)`, from an id `GlyphComponent(uint id)`, from a name `GlyphComponent(string name)` or as `GlyphComponent(uint id, QTransform tx, double w, bool ua)`.

fontlab.flEvent.doc: An event with `type` (EventType) and `modifiers` (int) attributes and an `EventType` dict. It is created as a copy `flEvent(flEvent)` or as `flEvent(EventType type[, int modifiers=-1])`.

fontlab.flLayerAttributes.doc: A data wrapper with the attributes `isActive`, `isLocked`, `isService`, `isVisible`, `isWireframe` and `wireframeColor`. The captured declaration exposes `asDict` (represent the object as a dictionary) and `asTuple` (represent it as a tuple).

fontlab.SmartCornerParameters.doc: A data wrapper with the single attribute `curvature`. The captured declaration exposes `asDict` (represent the object as a dictionary) and `asTuple` (represent it as a tuple).

fontgate.fgAxes.doc: An axes list representation with a `masters` attribute holding the masters (fgMasters). It is created as `fgAxes()` or as a copy `fgAxes(fgAxes)`.

fontgate.fgCaret.doc: A caret with a string `name` and a coordinate `v` (fgOtValue). It is created as `fgCaret()`, as a copy `fgCaret(fgCaret)` or from a coordinate and name as `fgCaret((fgOtValue/float/int, 'name'))`.

fontgate.fgDesignPosition.doc: A design position whose `data` attribute is a list of doubles. It is created as `fgDesignPosition()`, as a copy `fgDesignPosition(fgDesignPosition)` or from an axis count as `fgDesignPosition(axisCount)`.

fontgate.fgDeviceRecord.doc: A device record with int attributes `ppm` and `correction`. It is created as `fgDeviceRecord()`, as a copy `fgDeviceRecord(fgDeviceRecord)`, from a tuple `fgDeviceRecord(tuple(int ppm, int correction))` or as `fgDeviceRecord(int ppm, int correction)`.

fontgate.fgAnchors.doc: A list of anchor objects. The captured declaration exposes `append`, `asList`, `clean`, `del_` and `insert`. The native spelling of `del_` is del, which the capture says to reach through getattr on the native object.

fontlab.flSnaps.doc: A holder of snap constants. The captured declaration exposes the dict attributes `FastGuidelines`, `MarkerFlags`, `MarkerKey`, `SnapLineFlags`, `SnapMode`, `SnapStyle` and `ViewMode`; it has no methods beyond the constructor.

fontlab.PaintBrushShape.doc: A data wrapper for a brush shape. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `cap0`, `cap1`, `cap_length0`, `cap_length1` and `data`, and the methods `asDict` and `asTuple`, which represent the object as a dictionary or a tuple.

fontlab.flMouseEvent.doc: A mouse event. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `button`, `buttons`, `delta`, `firstPressed`, `global_`, `modifiers`, `movement`, `origin`, `prev` and `type`. It is created as a copy `flMouseEvent(flMouseEvent)`.

fontlab.flModel.doc: A static-only model class with no constructor. The captured declaration exposes the methods `createObject`, `getClassMask`, `instance`, `isClassMask`, `notifyGlyphChanged`, `notifyGlyphUpdate`, `notifyGlyphsChanged` and `typeToStr`, and the dict attributes `ModelType` and `ObjectParameter`. Call `instance` to obtain the flModel object.

fontlab.ExportControl.doc: An export control record. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `conflictMode`, `contentMode`, `contentName`, `destinationFolder`, `destinationMode`, `groupFamily`, `groupProfiles`, `profileId` and `profileName`, and the methods `init`, `load` and `store`. `load` returns a bool.

fontgate.fgAxis.doc: An axis. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `blendMap`, `map`, `name`, `shortName` and `type`. It is created as `fgAxis('name')`, which sets the name.

fontgate.fgMaster.doc: A master. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `name`, `penColor` and `position`. It is created as `fgMaster()`, as a copy `fgMaster(fgMaster)` or as `fgMaster('name')`.

fontgate.fgMasters.doc: A list of fgMaster objects. The captured declaration exposes `append`, `asList`, `clean`, `del_` and `insert`. The native spelling of `del_` is del, which the capture says to reach through getattr on the native object.

fontgate.fgGuide.doc: A guide. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `color`, `horizontal`, `index`, `name`, `p0`, `p1`, `position` and `vertical`, and the method `copy`. It is created as `fgGuide()`, as a copy `fgGuide(fgGuide)`, as `fgGuide(float pos[, bool horizontal = false])` or as `fgGuide(fgPoint p0, fgPoint p1[, name=''[, horizonta=false[, color=fgColor]]])`.

fontgate.fgComponent.doc: A component. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `baseGlyph`, `box`, `hasFullMatrix`, `index`, `matrix`, `offset` and `scale`, and the methods `draw`, `drawPoints` and `move`. `draw` takes a segment pen, `drawPoints` takes a point pen, and `move` takes float dx and dy. It is created as `fgComponent()`, as a copy `fgComponent(fgComponent)` or as `fgComponent('name', fgMatrix)`.

fontgate.fgBrush.doc: A stroke brush. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `kind`, `solid`, `thickness`, `contrast`, `rotation`, `proportion`, `join_type`, `miter_limit`, `tolerance`, `remove_overlap`, `cap0` and `cap1`, and the methods `asDict`, `asTuple`, `black`, `isBlack`, `isTransparent` and `transparent`. FontLab 9.1 removed the old size attribute; use `thickness` and the other stroke members.

fontgate.fgCmapRecord.doc: A cmap record. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `eid`, `format`, `lid`, `nid`, `pagename`, `pid` and `type`, and the methods `asDict` and `asTuple`.

fontgate.fgCoding.doc: Coding data. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `cmaps`, `codepageRange`, `encoding`, `encodingType`, `importedEncoding` and `unicodeRange`. It is created as `fgCoding()`, as a copy `fgCoding(fgCoding)` or as `fgCoding(bool [unicodeRange], bool [codepageRange], fgCMaps cmaps, fgEncoding encoding, fgEncoding importedEncoding, 'encDefault'/'encStandard'/'encCustom')`.

fontgate.fgCuspPoint.doc: A cusp point. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `hlink0`, `hlink1`, `index`, `middleH`, `middleV`, `p`, `vlink0` and `vlink1`. It is created as `fgCuspPoint()` or as a copy `fgCuspPoint(fgCuspPoint)`.

fontgate.fgGaspRecord.doc: A gasp record. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `rangeMaxpPPEM` and the behavior constants `DOGRAY`, `GRIDFIT`, `SYMMETRIC_GRIDFIT` and `SYMMETRIC_SMOOTHING`, and the methods `addSymmetry`, `rangeGaspBehavior` and `set`. It is created as `fgGaspRecord()`, as a copy `fgGaspRecord(fgGaspRecord)` or as `fgGaspRecord(int rangeMaxPPEM, int rangeGaspBehavior)`.

fontgate.fgHintCommand.doc: A hint command. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `code`, `index`, `pointName` and `subrIndex`. It is created as `fgHintCommand()`, as a copy `fgHintCommand(fgHintCommand)` or as `fgHintCommand(code, index)`, where the possible values for code are 'none'/'hintH'/'hintV'/'replace'.

fontgate.fgLib.doc: A dictionary with font- or glyph-related data. The captured declaration exposes the methods `clear`, `get`, `hasKey`, `items`, `keys` and `update`.

fontgate.fgMaxP.doc: The maxp table values. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `maxFunctionDefs`, `maxInstructionDefs`, `maxStackElements`, `maxStorage`, `maxTwilightPoints` and `maxZones`, and the methods `asDict` and `asTuple`.

fontgate.fgMetricsClass.doc: A metrics class. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `glyphs`, `keyGlyphName`, `left`, `name`, `right` and `width`, and the method `hasGlyph`. It is created as `fgMetricsClass()` or as a copy `fgMetricsClass(fgMetricsClass)`.

fontgate.fgOtValue.doc: An OpenType value. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `coordinate`, `deviceTable` and `point_index`. It is created as `fgOtValue()`, as a copy `fgOtValue(fgOtValue)`, from a float as `fgOtValue(float)` or from an int or long as `fgOtValue(int/long)`. The captured math operations are `fgOtValue + fgOtValue`, `fgOtValue - fgOtValue` and `fgOtValue * float`.

fontlab.FaBasicPtr.doc: A fix-pointer record. The captured declaration exposes the method `fix` and the attributes `canBeFixed`, `contour`, `id`, `location`, `nodeIndex`, `priority`, `report`, `title` and `vector`. Test `canBeFixed` before calling `fix`; the captured `fix` is declared as returning an flGlyph or nothing.

fontlab.FontLayer.doc: A font layer object. The captured declaration exposes no named members, only a native constructor. Do not rely on any attribute of `FontLayer`; glyph layers belong to flLayer.

fontlab.LocationValue.doc: A location value, `LocationValue`. The captured declaration exposes no named members, only the native constructors `LocationValue(flLocation)` and `LocationValue(double)`.

fontlab.flLocation.doc: A design-space location. The captured declaration exposes no named members, only the native constructors `flLocation()` and `flLocation(flLocation)`. The flAxis method locationName takes an flLocation.

fontlab.flHintingParameters.doc: Font-level hinting parameters. The captured declaration exposes the method `init` and the attributes `blueFuzz`, `blueScale`, `blueShift`, `codePPM`, `dropoutPPM`, `flex`, `fontDirectionHint`, `forceBold`, `forceBoldTreshold`, `lowestRecPPEM`, `maxFunctionDefs`, `maxInstructionDefs`, `maxStackElements`, `maxStorage`, `maxTwilightPoints`, `maxZones`, `stemSnapLimit` and `zonePPM`. It is created as `flHintingParameters()`. Note the captured spelling `forceBoldTreshold`.

fontlab.flAxis.doc: A variation axis. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `name`, `tag`, `shortName`, `minimal`, `default`, `maximum`, `designMin`, `designDef`, `designMax`, `hidden`, `map` and `playRange`, and methods including `checkValue`, `getRange`, `mappedValue`, `normalize`, `styleName`, `styleValue`, `valueWeight` and `valueWidth`. It is created as `flAxis()`, `flAxis(string name)` or `flAxis(string name, string tag, string short_name)`.

fontlab.flSticker.doc: A sticker object on the canvas. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `text`, `textRect`, `shape` and `boundingBox`, and the method `move`. It is created as `flSticker()`, `flSticker(flObject)`, `flSticker(flSticker)` or `flSticker(QString)`. It also carries the shared object members `name`, `id`, `type`, `isValid`, `release` and `remove`.

fontlab.flTransform.doc: A transform object. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `transform` and `scale` and the methods `map`, `mapRect` and `translate`. It is created as `flTransform()`, `flTransform(flTransform)`, `flTransform(flObject)` or `flTransform(QTransform)`. It also carries the shared object members `name`, `id`, `type`, `isValid`, `release` and `remove`.

fontlab.flPaper.doc: A paper object holding glyph information. The captured declaration exposes the methods `activeGlyphInfo`, `getGlyphInfo`, `glyphInfoAt`, `glyphsBoundRect`, `hasActive`, `hasContent`, `glyph`, `setActiveGlyph` and `setPaperGlyph`. It is created as `flPaper()`, `flPaper(flPaper)`, `flPaper(flObject)` or `flPaper(QBrush)`. It also carries the shared object members `name`, `id`, `type`, `isValid`, `release` and `remove`.

fontlab.flProperty.doc: A property object. The captured declaration exposes the property accessors `getProperty`, `getPropertyInt`, `getPropertyFloat`, `setProperty`, `setPropertyInt` and `setPropertyFloat`, and the attribute `objectAttr`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `name`, `id`, `type`, `isValid`, `release` and `remove`.

fontlab.TransformFrame.doc: A transformation frame. The captured declaration exposes the transformation methods `translate`, `scale`, `rotate`, `rotate180`, `slant`, `flipHorizontal`, `flipVertical`, `horizontalReflection`, `verticalReflection` and `doTransformation`, the geometry methods `boundingRect`, `polygon`, `expandPolygon`, `getMapped`, `getTransform`, `initCenter` and `prepareTransformations`, the control methods `getControlPos`, `setControlPos` and `setProjectionPos`, the size and margin methods `bw`, `lh`, `mb`, `mh`, `ml`, `mr`, `mt`, `mw`, `rh` and `tw`, and the attributes `tl`, `tr`, `bl`, `br` and `cr`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads.

fontlab.fgSymbolList.doc: A list of symbols. The captured declaration exposes the list methods `append`, `insert`, `remove`, `replace`, `clear`, `at`, `last`, `mid`, `size`, `empty`, `assign`, `compare` and `equals`, the loading methods `set`, `setList`, `setGlyphsList`, `setIdList`, `setNamesList`, `setUnicodeList`, `setData`, `setString` and `setSterile`, and the reading and storage methods `data`, `string`, `symbols`, `computeString`, `store`, `restore`, `reserve`, `clearData`, `clearString` and `limitLineLength`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads.

fontlab.YPanelManager.doc: A panel manager. The captured declaration exposes the signals `desktopClientRectChanged`, `panelClosed`, `toolbarOpened` and `toolbarClosed` and the method `showContextMenu`. It also carries the Qt object members `parent`, `children`, `findChild`, `findChildren`, `setParent`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `deleteLater` and `property`, and the attribute `objectName`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads.

fontlab.flGraphicsInfo.doc: Graphics information. The captured declaration exposes the attribute `transform`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flAuditInfo.doc: Audit information. The captured declaration exposes `glyphLocation`, and the attributes `basic`, `item`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flPropertyDouble.doc: A numeric property. The captured declaration exposes the attributes `value`, `expression`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flPropertyPoint.doc: A point property. The captured declaration exposes `hasExpression`, and the attributes `point`, `paramType`, `ParameterType`, `expressionX`, `expressionY`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flSearchInfo.doc: Search information. The captured declaration exposes `combine`, and the attributes `dist`, `glyphInfo`, `transform`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flModelProducer.doc: A model producer. The captured declaration exposes `copyToClipboard`, `getClipboardData`, `getObjectsFromClipboard`, `getObjectsFromData`, `countGlyphsInData`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flBasicTool.doc: A basic tool. The captured declaration exposes `activateTool`, `deactivateTool`, and the attributes `cursorId`, `needDeactivateParent`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flExpression.doc: Expression holder. The captured declaration exposes `expression`, `hasExpression`, `hasError`, `error`, `clearError`, `isNeedToComplete`, `resetReady`, `ready` and `variables`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flMarkerPoint.doc: Marker point. The captured declaration exposes `markerFlag`, `setMarkerFlag`, `markerFlags`, `isStem`, `isSelected`, `key` and `position`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads. It also carries the shared object members `changed`, `clone`, `cloneObject`, `getProperty`, `setProperty`, `release`, `remove` and `update` and the shared attributes `id`, `name`, `type`, `isValid` and `isNull`.

fontlab.flShapeBuilder.doc: Shape builder. The captured declaration exposes `deactivate`, `getSmartNodes`, `hasFeature`, `init`, `prepareTransformationData`, `resetTransformationData`, `setDestShape`, `setDestShapeData`, `setOwnerLayer`, `setOwnerShapeData`, `canUngroup`, `haveResult` and `title`. It is created with no captured constructor overloads.
